import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()
n = int(data[0])
m = int(data[1])

# Count the number of x values with each remainder modulo 5
x_counts = [0] * 5
for x in range(1, n + 1):
    x_counts[x % 5] += 1

# Count the number of y values with each remainder modulo 5
y_counts = [0] * 5
for y in range(1, m + 1):
    y_counts[y % 5] += 1

# Calculate the number of valid pairs
valid_pairs = 0
for i in range(5):
    # We need (i + j) % 5 == 0, which means j % 5 == (5 - i) % 5
    j = (5 - i) % 5
    valid_pairs += x_counts[i] * y_counts[j]

print(valid_pairs)

import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n, m = map(int, data)

for x in range(1, n+1):
    count += (m - (x % 5)) // 5 + 1

print(count)
